thread:
marta_cs: Heads-up — SageCrest (healthtech) asked for EU egress allowlist + a temporary soft rate-limit bump for onboarding demo next Monday. They process sensitive PHI so security team wants a short-lived escrow and audit log.
ashley_ops: Got it. Do we have the IPs from them yet? also they asked about auto-revoke after the demo window. :calendar:
marta_cs: They sent the list in the email earlier: 18.200.12.34, 18.200.12.35 and 18.201.45.99. Preference is /32 for app nodes, and a /24 for their on-prem proxy if possible. Auto-revoke = 48h after start.
linh_sre: I can stage in edge-eu-west-1 and apply a scoped allowlist. For rate limits — what magnitude? they mentioned +12% for burst demo but we usually do discrete qps.
rafael_pm: Keep it conservative: bump per-customer qps by 15% (token-based) for 48h, and monitor latency + errors. If any anomalies, we roll back. Also add an annotation for security review.
ashley_ops: Copy. I'll create a provisional ticket and link to contract clause about data handling. provisioning steps below.
provision-bot: Ticket CS-8421 created by ashley_ops — "SageCrest EU allowlist + soft-rl bump (48h)". Assigned: linh_sre. ETA: 3h.
linh_sre: Planning patch (preview):
```
allowlist:
  - 18.200.12.34/32  # app-node-1
  - 18.200.12.35/32  # app-node-2
  - 18.201.45.99/32  # on-prem-proxy
  - 18.201.45.0/24   # proxy-range (requested)
egress_region: eu-west-1
rate_limit_adjustment:
  type: soft-bump
  percent: 15
  duration: 48h
auto_revoke: 2026-04-05T15:00:00Z
notes: "PHI handling — audit trail required; security notified"
```
linh_sre: Will apply to the tenant-scoped policy, create a temporary ACL + AWS security group mirror. I'll push as canary to one host first.
marta_cs: Please tag security and ops during rollout — they want the audit stream forwarded. Also flag renewal risk: sales asked that we avoid any hiccups during their month-end procurement review.
rafael_pm: I added a renewal note in the account: customer is on 6mo pilot; completion and no incidents -> high chance of conversion. Any rollback raises escalation risk.
ashley_ops: Thanks — i'll send the customer the expected window and the revocation timestamp. Quick reply draft for them: "We will provision EU allowlist and a 15% temporary throughput increase for 48 hours starting at your confirmed demo time. Access will be auto-revoked at UTC 2026-04-05T15:00 unless extended by request. Security and audit logs will be shared post-demo." Want me to send now?
marta_cs: send now. also attach the minimal SOC/secure-handling checklist.
provision-bot: lin_sre updated policy -> staged on edge-eu-west-1 canary host. Change ID: ch_0b9f7a. Monitoring hooks attached.
linh_sre: Canary looks good — no errors, tailing logs clean. I'll complete global rollout in 20m and notify here.
ashley_ops: Customer replied "thanks — confirmed 2026-04-03 09:00 UTC start". All good to proceed. :white_check_mark:
linh_sre: Rolled out globally for the tenant. ACLs applied, rate bump active. Audit stream forwarded to sagecrest-audit S3 prefix per compliance.
marta_cs: amazing — mark CS-8421 as DONE once you confirm auto-revoke scheduled. Also add post-demo check-in call with customer success and security.
provision-bot: Scheduled revoke job set for 2026-04-05T15:00Z. CS-8421 moved to "awaiting post-demo review".
rafael_pm: Post-demo checklist: 1) verify no increased 5xx or latency, 2) export audit logs, 3) confirm customer didn't hit throttles unexpectedly, 4) confirm renewal touchpoint scheduled.
marta_cs: I'll book the 30m review for 2026-04-05 16:00 UTC and follow up on renewal pipeline. Thanks team! :pray:
